question.problem: The exact distance between the points $(3,6)$ and $(2,-4)$ is{{field-1}}.
question.worked_solution:
In this case, we have ${{(3,6)}_{⏟}}_{\text{(}{x}_{1}\text{,}\,{y}_{1})}$ and ${{(2,-4)}_{⏟}}_{\text{(}{x}_{2}\text{,}\,{y}_{2})}.$ 
So, the distance $d$ can be calculated using the distance formula, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}d & =\sqrt{({x}_{2}-{x}_{1})^{2}+({y}_{2}-{y}_{1})^{2}} \\  & =\sqrt{(2-3)^{2}+(-4-6)^{2}} \\  & =\sqrt{(-1)^{2}+(-10)^{2}} \\  & =\sqrt{1+100} \\  & =\sqrt{101}\end{aligned}
$$
